{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u066/system/state/workspace/programs/task-b9472fc4.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The grid is a tiled field: divider rows/columns have one dominant
    # line color, while the other rows/columns are dominated by the fill.
    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] for c in range(w)]
    rc, cc = Counter(row_modes), Counter(col_modes)
    candidates = set(row_modes) & set(col_modes)
    line_color = min(candidates, key=lambda x: (rc[x] + cc[x], -min(rc[x], cc[x])))

    line_rows = [r for r, v in enumerate(row_modes) if v == line_color]
    line_cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(col_modes) if v == line_color]

    # Non-line cells at divider intersections are the colored corner markers.
    marked = [(ri, ci) for ri, r in enumerate(line_rows)
              for ci, c in enumerate(line_cols) if grid[r][c] != line_color]
    if not marked:
        return [[Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != line_color).most_common(1)[0][0]]]
    r0 = min(x[0] for x in marked)
    r1 = max(x[0] for x in marked)
    c0 = min(x[1] for x in marked)
    c1 = max(x[1] for x in marked)

    fill_color = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != line_color).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        row = []
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            corners = [grid[line_rows[i]][line_cols[j]],
                       grid[line_rows[i]][line_cols[j + 1]],
                       grid[line_rows[i + 1]][line_cols[j]],
                       grid[line_rows[i + 1]][line_cols[j + 1]]]
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] != line_color and all(x == corners[0] for x in corners) else fill_color)
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
}
